env.gpu_form_factor: SXM5 (NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, 700 W power limit; nvidia-smi does not print SXM in the name)
env.triton_cache_dir: node-local /tmp, empty at the start of each autotune process
env.platform: GPU cluster, 1 x H100 80GB HBM3 (Slurm job, node-local /tmp Python env)

method:
python ch6_measure_2p14.py steady   --out r1.json        # vector add, softmax, matmul, GROUP_SIZE_M
    python ch6_measure_2p14.py fused    --out f1.json        # RMSNorm (Gemma), LayerNorm, QuickGELU + dropout
    python ch6_measure_2p14.py sweep    --out s1.json        # 48-shape softmax sweep, with torch.compile
    python ch6_measure_2p14.py autotune --mode cold    --out a1.json   # first call, empty Triton cache
    python ch6_measure_2p14.py autotune --mode prewarm --out p1.json   # same, hand kernel run first (as the notebook)
    python ch6_measure_2p14.py aggregate --out final.json r*.json a*.json p*.json

Timers: "nb" is the notebook's cuda_time with its defaults (CUDA events, median of 50 calls after 10 warm-up
calls); "nb200" is the same timer with 200 calls after 25 warm-up calls (the 2026-11-23 matmul_sizes runs);
"do_bench" is triton.testing.do_bench(fn, warmup=25, rep=200), median.
GPU clocks, power limit, temperature and clock-event reasons are recorded before and after each process.

notes: Run 2026-11-25 03:11-03:30 UTC (2026-11-24 US Eastern). Two jobs: the main run, and a second job for the fused kernels after the first fused attempt failed (QuickGELU kernel: tl.exp on FP16 input does not compile; the activation is measured in FP32, the notebook dtype). GPU time: 20 min 47 s + 3 min 42 s on 1 x H100.

Clock event 0x4 (SW power cap) at 1845-1860 MHz of 1980 MHz after every steady process (580-630 W drawn): the 4,096-cubed matmuls ran up to 7% below the maximum SM clock. Other snapshots: idle (0x1) or none.

Vector-add sizes: footprint = x, y and out together (3 x 4 bytes per element). 1,048,576 elements = 12 MiB, 89,478,485 elements = 1 GiB. At 12 MiB both timers are dominated by per-call launch time, not by L2 bandwidth.

Gemma decode: google/gemma-2b-it FP16, SDPA, 512-token prompt, 20 new tokens, eager dynamic cache (Chapter 4 method); the chapter Triton RMSNorm patched into all 37 GemmaRMSNorm modules with weight (1 + w); MLP not patched.
